in_marathi.name: Rohidas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohidas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rohidas is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'Divine Bowman'. It is derived from the name of Lord Rama's greatest warrior, Jatayu, also known as Rohan, who tried to protect Sita from Ravana.
